_note: Phone messages. {name} = you, {opp} = next opponent, {club} = your club, {odds}, {stake}, {win}, {cup}, {round}, {home}, {away}, {date}.

start.text: So proud of you love. Don't forget your gumshield. Or your sandwiches. Mum x
Your Gran's opened a betting account. Make me proud. And rich.
Seen a lot of lads come through here, {name}. You'll either play for England or end up selling double glazing. 50/50. Socks are in your locker.

granOdds: {odds} for you to score against {opp}. I've had {stake} on it. No pressure, pet.
granWon: YOU SCORED!! I've won {win}. Getting a new hip.
Get in!! {win} up. Your grandad's turning in his grave, he always said you were rubbish.
granLost: Didn't score. That's my bingo money gone. Still love you.
No goal. I've told Ladbrokes it's a fix.
granBenched: Not even on the pitch?! I want my stake back.
Sat on the bench all game. I could have done that, and I've got a bad knee.
gafferAngry: The Gaffer: My office. Monday. Bring a rod.
The Gaffer: You were about as sharp as a wet sponge today, son.
gafferHappy: The Gaffer: That's what I call a catch, son.
The Gaffer: Lovely stuff. Keep your line in the water.
kitman: Dennis (kit man): Had a dream you scored with your knee. Wear knee pads, just in case.
Dennis (kit man): You'll get a nosebleed in March. Pack tissues.
Dennis (kit man): Mark my words, you'll meet someone important on a Tuesday. Probably the bus driver.
Dennis (kit man): Your left boot's unlucky. Can't explain it. I just know.
Dennis (kit man): Someone will offer you a business opportunity involving slippers. Say no.
shark: Unknown number: Tony here. Super-agent. You don't know me but I know you. Let's do lunch. Bring your mum's bank details.
Unknown number: Kevin, Elite Global Premium Talent Management Ltd. We should talk. I've got a mate at Real Madrid. Well, he's been to Madrid.

birthday.text: Happy 17th birthday love! Cake's in the fridge. Your Gran's put money on you eating all of it.

cupOut: Knocked out of the {cup}. Dennis says he saw it coming.

selection.sub: Team sheet's up. You're on the bench.
selection.none: Team sheet's up. You're not in the squad. You'll be watching from the stand with a Bovril.
